preregistration.operator: Codex session on behalf of the repository owner

study.research_question: On all 30 pinned MCPMark Verified filesystem/standard tasks, how do GEODE and Codex compare when both use the GPT-5.4 ChatGPT subscription route at high effort?
study.research_gap: No infrastructure-valid 30-pair run exists. Preserved pilots exposed shared-fixture extraction races, a runner argument defect, false GEODE convergence, exception-shaped verifier receipts, and unequal failure boundaries. This run starts only after serial fixture freezing, round-level convergence repair, verifier guards, strict empty-response handling, equal hard wall deadlines, and escaped runtime-error invalidation.
study.hypothesis: On one complete paired pass over 30 tasks, GEODE verifier accuracy will be no more than 10 percentage points below Codex and GEODE will use fewer native-reported input tokens.

primary_metric.name: paired_verifier_accuracy_delta
primary_metric.aggregation: (GEODE verifier passes across 30 tasks - Codex verifier passes across 30 tasks) / 30

study.decision_rule: Support the hypothesis only if all 30 task pairs are infrastructure-valid, the paired verifier accuracy delta is at least -0.10, and total native-reported GEODE input tokens are lower than Codex; otherwise report mixed or unsupported without promotion.
study.invalidation_rule: Stop on a route, model, effort, GEODE revision, Codex revision, upstream harness revision, verifier patch digest, task count/order, fixture reset, or verifier identity mismatch. Missing native result, trajectory, or verifier receipt invalidates the attempt. An escaped setup, provider, hook, or programming exception is infrastructure-invalid. A recovered ordinary model retry, model action error, hard outer 1200-second timeout, and ordinary verifier failure remain performance outcomes.
study.analysis_plan: Execute one task pair at a time with max concurrency one, alternating which arm runs first by task index. Report pass@1, paired discordances, accuracy delta, native input/output/reasoning/cache counters, MCP calls, wall time, retry evidence, and failure classes. Do not claim pass@k, causal runtime parity, or publication-grade uncertainty from one repetition. Exclude preserved infrastructure-invalid pilots from the primary denominator and publish them only as failure lineage.

harness.name: MCPMark Verified filesystem/standard with verifier guard patch

environment.reset_strategy: Pre-materialize and digest all ten shared fixture categories. For each task and arm, upstream MCPMark creates a fresh PID-scoped backup, executes one arm, applies the same patched verifier, and cleans the backup before the next arm. Arm-first order alternates by task index.

execution.command_redacted: Run runner.sh. It validates all frozen revisions, patch and fixture digests, then invokes plugins.benchmark_harness.run_mcpmark serially for each ordered task with filesystem/standard, GPT-5.4 high, k=1, timeout=1200, and subscription authentication. OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy satisfies upstream argument preflight only.

comparison.comparator: Codex CLI 0.145.0 at source revision dad1db87bb5ad4b92af6b0f58502d12453681f81

privacy.redaction_boundary: Keep raw logs, messages, fixture paths, tool bodies, subscription diagnostics, local absolute paths, sessions, and credentials private. Publish only reviewed summaries, verifier-bound outcomes, reduced trajectory releases, portable relative references, hashes, and allowlisted metadata.
